source_evidence: If you do not object promptly after receiving notification of a transaction, you might not be able to contest it later.
question: Misconception: “If I notice an unauthorized transaction on my account statement, I can wait to report it; I’ll still be able to contest it later.”
answer: Correction: Read account statements promptly and object right away if something is wrong. The source warns that delaying an objection may mean you cannot contest the transaction later, and says objecting in writing can better protect your rights.
